page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas.

main_text.p: Sclopetario-rum capi-tanei,nunc cohortium praefectiQuinetiam scloppetariorum praefecti qua-tuor diu in civitate fuere, à senatu quoque designati, perpetui. Hi curam armorum habebant, juventutemque maximè exercebant in tractandis scloppetis, foro venalis annonæ, quæ ad urbem defertur quotidie, præstant: à pistoribus & iis, qui cerevisiam coquunt, ne quid fraudis committeretur, ut justa esset ponderum & mensurarum ratio in officinis, cœ-num ut publicis locis amoveretur, procurabant. Quæ omnia nunc ad centurio-nes oppidanos octo, qui iis successêre, translata sunt. Denique ÆDILES duo in Reip.De Ædili-bus Trib. Potest. & societati-bus plebeis sunt Trib. potestatis, quam non lege datam, sed paulatim nitendo longiùs tubulentis[?] actionibus quæsitam proximis sæculis usurparunt non magno sanè Reip. bono. Horum magnum esse nomen solet. Et quoniam cum plebe opificum & institorum connexi sunt, ac ab eâ dependent, de plebis hujus ordine & distinctione paucâ hic dicam. page.notes: Printed text is in a single column. The left margin holds two notes: the first beside the opening paragraph ("Sclopetario-rum capi-tanei, nunc cohortium praefecti"), the second beside the sentence on the Aediles ("De Ædili-bus Trib. Potest. & societati-bus plebeis"). Doubtful readings: "tubulentis" (possibly printed as it stands) and the spelling "scloppetariorum"/"scloppetis" (the first letter looks like long s). "praestant" is printed "praetant" and is kept as printed; the rendering "præstant" in the text above may need checking against the scan. Running head and page number are read from the top of the page. The paragraph ends at "co-" because the catchword "quendæ" stands below the last full line.
